decks.notes: This deck focuses on using a variety of creatures with different abilities to create powerful combos that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Birds of Paradise, Endurance, and Nadu, Winged Wisdom, the player can search for specific creatures they need for their strategy. Cards like Chord of Calling and Urza's Saga help tutor for key pieces, while Teferi, Time Raveler can disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck excels at adapting to different situations and finding the right creatures to clinch victory.

This deck focuses on generating massive amounts of mana quickly through rituals and medallions, using the card advantage from Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wish to combo off with Glimpse the Impossible and Past in Flames. The key strategy is to ramp up mana as fast as possible, dig through the deck for combo pieces, and eventually cast a game-winning spell with a huge storm count. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion option for extra consistency in mana production. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swift and powerful flurry of spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with various abilities to create a powerful combo strategy. By tutoring for specific creatures using cards like Chord of Calling and Finale of Devastation, the player can adapt to different situations and quickly assemble a winning board state. Cards like Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth and Urza's Saga help ramp up mana production, while cards like Springheart Nantuko and Nadu, Winged Wisdom provide key combo pieces. The deck also has protective elements like Sylvan Safekeeper and Malevolent Rumble to keep the combo pieces safe.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of powerful Eldrazi creatures and artifacts, while also exploiting the synergy between the Urza lands to quickly ramp up mana. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with removal and hand disruption, while also establishing a strong board presence with threats like Emrakul, the World Anew and Karn, the Great Creator. By utilizing the Tron lands and Eldrazi Temple, the deck can quickly cast its powerful spells and overwhelm the opponent.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, while also removing threats with Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat that can quickly close out the game, while Psychic Frog and Subtlety can help dig for answers or deal with problematic cards. The deck aims to control the pace of the game and win through incremental advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of mill effects and control cards to quickly deplete the opponent's library, forcing them to draw from an empty deck and lose the game. Cards like Ruin Crab, Archive Trap, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter are used to mill cards from the opponent's library, while control cards like Path to Exile and Surgical Extraction are used to disrupt their game plan. By efficiently milling the opponent's library and controlling the board, this deck aims to win through mill rather than traditional damage.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through rituals and accelerants to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage, and Glimpse the Impossible to create a storm count. Past in Flames is used to recur spells from the graveyard, with Wrenn's Resolve providing protection. The goal is to build a large storm count to deal massive damage to the opponent, utilizing cards like Ruby Medallion and Valakut Awakening to keep the combo going. The deck also uses Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion to provide additional mana ramp and consistency.

Utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful enchantments, this deck aims to gain control of the game and dictate the pace of play. By using cards like Force of Negation, Counterspell, and Subtlety to disrupt the opponent's plans, while also utilizing cards like Wrath of the Skies and Teferi, Time Raveler to maintain control of the battlefield, this deck excels at grinding out victories through resource management and strategic decision-making. The inclusion of The One Ring as a win condition adds an extra layer of inevitability to the deck's late-game dominance.

The deck revolves around assembling a toolbox of creatures to generate a powerful combo. It includes cards that search for specific creatures, like Chord of Calling and Finale of Devastation, as well as creatures that serve different purposes, such as Nadu, Winged Wisdom for card draw and Wall of Roots for mana ramp. The deck also includes disruption elements like Malevolent Rumble and Suncleanser to control the board state. By tutoring for the right creature at the right time, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) to quickly ramp up to big colorless threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also utilizes Eldrazi Temple and Expedition Map to further accelerate mana production and fetch key lands. Control elements like All Is Dust and Thought-Knot Seer help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Kozilek's Command and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon provide versatile removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful, hard-to-deal-with threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counter spells, removal, and powerful enchantments like The One Ring to dominate the battlefield. It also utilizes card draw and manipulation to maintain card advantage and control the flow of the game. With a combination of powerful creatures and versatile spells, the deck aims to outsmart and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck aims to control the game through the use of powerful artifacts and Eldrazi creatures, while also utilizing the UrzaTron land package to generate a large amount of mana. With cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having access to powerful threats like Emrakul, the World Anew and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. By assembling the UrzaTron lands and utilizing cards like Expedition Map and Urza's Saga, the deck can quickly establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing various control spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage. It combines hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek with counterspells like Force of Negation and Counterspell to control the board. Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters provide threats and pressure, while cards like Archmage's Charm and Psychic Frog offer additional utility and card filtering. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient removal and countermagic, ultimately grinding out a win through card advantage and careful decision-making.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game, using efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt to clear the way for its creatures. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support and reach, while the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring offers flexibility and consistency in the deck's mana base.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game and outvalue the opponent using powerful control cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Counterspell. The deck also focuses on removal with Fatal Push and Toxic Deluge while using The One Ring as a win condition. Snapcaster Mage provides extra value by recasting spells from the graveyard, while Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Psychic Frog offer additional control options. The deck's mana base is designed to support its control elements and provide consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on using Ruby Storm components to create a powerful combo that generates mana and card advantage, allowing for explosive turns and potentially overwhelming opponents with a flurry of spells. By utilizing cards like Manamorphose, Pyretic Ritual, and Desperate Ritual, as well as Ral, Monsoon Mage's abilities, the goal is to cast multiple spells in a single turn to build towards a game-winning scenario. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra element of flexibility and consistency to the deck's strategy.
